defects.claim_says: 1976-01-01 (EO 12107 amendment substituting the Office of Personnel Management for the Civil Service Commission)
defects.source_says: EO 12107 (44 FR 1055, signed 1978-12-28) section 2-404: 'Except as otherwise specifically provided in this Order, this Order shall be effective on January 1, 1979.' The claim's own judgment_reason and research_rationale give 1979-01-01; a 1976 effective date precedes the amending order's signature by almost three years and is internally inconsistent.

defects.claim_says: The order still operates as written for 'a Treasury Department employee' with recommendation by 'the Secretary of the Treasury, or his designee'; the claim does not mention any transfer of the protective function.
defects.source_says: The held 2024 OPM Schedule B listing (fr-2024-16723) places the Secret Service protective positions under the Department of Homeland Security (Sch. B, 213.3211(b)), and the held 5 CFR 9701.604(d)(15) is a DHS regulation. The claim does not identify or source the legal basis (the 2003 Homeland Security Act transfer and its references/savings provisions, or any amending order) by which sections 1, 1(2), 3 and 4, which name the Treasury Department and the Secretary of the Treasury, still have a current predicate. The continuing-operation finding is therefore not supported for those clauses as written.

defects.claim_says: only the order's own Federal Register text, the 1989 OFR codification, the eCFR text of 5 CFR 9701.604 and Executive Order 12107 name it
defects.source_says: A held-text number search (cruden, 51,241 readable files) also finds jobs/selden-fr-citers/output/texts/fr-05-22067.txt and fr-2024-16723.txt naming 'Executive Order 11203'; the search description is inaccurate (the 2024 listing is cited elsewhere in the rationale, the 2005 listing is not mentioned).

reasoning: Hashes of jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_11203.txt (0af81452...) and EO_12107.txt (e734f497...) match; all 31 quoted spans match the bytes at the stated offsets. Identity confirmed: number 11203, title, 30 FR 3417, signing 1965-03-12 (OCR of date is garbled; the 1989 OFR codification and the FR catalog give Mar. 12, 1965), signed by Lyndon B. Johnson, FR Doc. 65-2731. The 13-clause inventory is complete against the full text. The only Federal Register disposition note is 'Amended by: EO 12107, December 28, 1978', which the claim addresses, and EO 12107 section 2-101(b) does list 11203. No earlier revocation, supersession or own-terms end was found in held texts. Rejected because the later_events on sections 1(3), 1(4) and 5 give the EO 12107 amendment an effective date of 1976-01-01, contradicting EO 12107 section 2-404 (effective 1979-01-01) and the claim's own judgment_reason; because the YES predicate does not address the transfer of the Secret Service protective function from Treasury to the Department of Homeland Security, which the held 2024 OPM listing shows; and because the earlier-end search description omits two held FR documents that name the order.
